digest.component_or_area: ticket planner shadow mode and manifest rendering
propositions: Shadow TicketPlan generation must produce mutations and dispositions matching legacy differ output except for explicitly named approved deltas
Preview output must extend with a new versioned lifecycle_intents top-level key while preserving all existing keys and mutation array bytes unchanged
Existing serialize_manifest canonical hash must remain byte-for-byte identical after additive lifecycle_intents section is added
Construction, check, dry-run, and shadow modes must perform zero repository saves, ticket writes, Jira calls, or subprocess launches
Parity comparison between shadow plans and legacy mutations must be pure and effect-free, reporting ticket identity and differing plan fields without unbounded content
